response.original_title: ((24*7_Guide)) How do I add a room in Saga Cruise?
response.overview: To add a room on a Saga Cruise, you must call their customer service at  +1-866-829-1280 or +44-204-586-5316 or contact your travel agent. To add someone to a room on Saga Cruise , you must contact customer service directly +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada)or speak with your travel agent. Additions cannot be made online or through the mobile app, and are subject to your current stateroom's capacity limit, total ship capacity, and lifeboat availability. If you need direct assistance, the quickest way to get help is by calling Saga Cruise customer service at +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada). Their expert representatives can guide you through the process, confirm room availability, and explain any additional costs involved. Understanding Saga Cruise  Room Occupancy Rules Before attempting to add someone to your stateroom, it’s important to understand Saga Cruise occupancy policies.
